kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نختصر (form VIII)
# نَخْتَصِرُ (naḵtaṣiru) /nax.ta.sˤi.ru/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِخْتَصَرَ (iḵtaṣara)
# نُخْتَصَرُ (nuḵtaṣaru) /nux.ta.sˤa.ru/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِخْتَصَرَ (iḵtaṣara)
# نَخْتَصِرَ (naḵtaṣira) /nax.ta.sˤi.ra/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِخْتَصَرَ (iḵtaṣara)
# نُخْتَصَرَ (nuḵtaṣara) /nux.ta.sˤa.r
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
